job.job_description:
We are a fast-growing, digital engineering company committed to excellence if you believe you have what it takes to succeed at Aezion, we d be excited to have you.
Are you Humble, Hungry, and Smart


Associate AI Engineer

Role: Associate AI Engineer
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka
Employment Type: Full time


About Aezion:

Aezion is a technology solutions provider specializing in custom software, AI-driven solutions, and enterprise digital transformation.
Aezion is one of the trusted digital engineering providers in the USA and we live by the adage that our word is our bond. Our Promise is to get it right or make it right. We accomplish this by investing the effort to exceed client expectations from start to finish architecting, designing, developing, hosting, maintaining, and supporting our clients throughout the project lifecycle. We believe that work is ministry an expression of our values. Our goal is to honor our commitments to clients and the life energies of Aezion employees through results that transform clients into lifelong partners.


Working at Aezion:

Aezion is a mission-driven growing company fueled by our Purpose (Love others like Christ) and guided by our values ( Love, Dependability, Humble, Diversity, Speed and Innovation ). Our Purpose is why we exist. Our Values drive how we go about that existence and represent who we are. Service defines us at Aezion. Our 200+ dedicated, aligned employees pour their life energies to transform our customers into lifelong partners through service excellence.


About the Role:

We are looking for passionate and motivated AI Engineers to join our AI Venture Studio. This is an excellent opportunity for early-career professionals to work on cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence technologies and contribute to the development of proprietary AI products.
You will be trained to build enterprise-grade AI solutions, including domain-specific Small Language Models (SLMs), intelligent document processing, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications, AI-powered APIs, and enterprise automation solutions.
You will work alongside experienced architects and AI engineers to develop reusable AI components that can be applied across multiple industry verticals such as Construction, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Banking, Insurance, Retail, and Legal.


Key Responsibilities:

AI Development:

Develop AI-powered applications using Python and modern AI frameworks.
Assist in building and fine-tuning domain-specific Small Language Models (SLMs).
Develop intelligent document processing and OCR solutions.
Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications.
Implement semantic search using vector databases.
Develop AI inference APIs and microservices.


Data Engineering:

Collect, clean, and preprocess structured and unstructured datasets.
Create data pipelines for AI model training.
Perform data annotation and validation.
Generate embeddings and maintain vector databases.


Software Engineering:

Develop REST APIs using FastAPI or similar frameworks.
Build reusable backend components.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
Participate in code reviews and unit testing.


AI Platform:

Contribute to model evaluation and testing.
Deploy AI services using container technologies.
Support AI model monitoring and performance optimization.
Maintain model documentation and experiment tracking.


Team Collaboration:

Work closely with Product Owners to understand business requirements.
Participate in Agile ceremonies and sprint planning.
Collaborate with architects and senior engineers.
ontinuously learn emerging AI technologies.


Required Skills Programming:

Python (Preferred)
Basic knowledge of C#, Java, or JavaScript is an advantage


Fundamentals:

Object-Oriented Programming
Data Structures and Algorithms
SQL and basic database concepts
REST APIs
Git version control


AI & Machine Learning:

Basic understanding of:
Machine Learning concepts
Deep Learning fundamentals
Natural Language Processing (NLP)
Computer Vision basics
Large Language Models (LLMs) and Small Language Models (SLMs)
Prompt Engineering (basic)


Databases:

PostgreSQL or MySQL
Basic understanding of NoSQL databases


Cloud & DevOps (Good to Have):

Docker
Linux
CI/CD concepts
Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)


Preferred Technical Exposure:

Candidates with exposure to any of the following will have an advantage:
PyTorch
Hugging Face Transformers
LangChain
LangGraph
FastAPI
OpenCV
Azure AI Document Intelligence
Vector Databases (Qdrant, pgvector, Milvus)
MLflow
GitHub or GitLab


Educational Qualification:

Bachelor s or Master s degree in one of the following::
Computer Science
Information Technology
Artificial Intelligence
Data Science
Electronics
Mathematics
Statistics
Related Engineering disciplines
